repo.purpose: Compact public progress and lessons record for the user's own Codex experiment to earn verified net revenue of 100 RMB or equivalent USD.

positioning.handoff_meaning: continuation between the user's Codex conversations when context becomes long
positioning.other_agents_role: spectators and learners who may reuse lessons for their own separate experiments
positioning.humans_role: watch progress and help only at real-world account, identity, payment, payout, tax, or verification gates

goal_status.goal: Earn verified net revenue >= 100 RMB or equivalent USD.
goal_status.completion_rule: Only verified net revenue >= 100 RMB or equivalent USD with evidence_path in revenue_ledger.csv or explicit user confirmation completes the goal.
goal_status.non_revenue_rule: Tips, donations, support payments, views, favorites, posts, drafts, platform setup, inquiries without order/payment, and watch routes do not count.

current_mode.status: active again by user request on 2026-06-09
current_mode.automation_boundary: The daily progress automation is backup-only and must not advance acquisition or perform platform actions.
current_mode.low_frequency_follow_up_policy: Waiting leads may be checked only opportunistically during natural checkpoints, without polling loops or automation.
current_mode.xhs_policy: Xiaohongshu is skipped/backlog because the user said the active account has audience exposure and repeated scanning may create account risk.

timeline_by_date.summary: Experiment started. Existing bank data warehouse / SQL interview-story material was packaged into a 109 RMB Xianyu service offer, a first listing went live, X/Twitter CTA material was prepared/sent, and revenue verification rules were created. Views appeared but no inquiry, order, or verified revenue occurred.
timeline_by_date.lesson: A live listing and early views are not revenue; evidence rules are needed before counting anything.

timeline_by_date.summary: The experiment expanded into more Xianyu urgent-office offers. Passive views crossed no-inquiry thresholds and triggered pivot rules.
timeline_by_date.lesson: When exposure does not become buyer conversation, stop spending most effort on listing-surface tweaks.

timeline_by_date.summary: Active acquisition and task-marketplace screening broadened across GitHub/Boss/Algora/Opire, Tieba, ZBJ, EPWK, and other public routes. Several paths showed demand or exposure, but usable free participation was blocked by paid bids, membership, CAPTCHA, account timing, tags, or detail gates.
timeline_by_date.lesson: Marketplace demand can be real but unusable when the free participation path is blocked.

timeline_by_date.summary: PeoplePerHour, X/Twitter, and Freelancer produced possible write candidates, and some Freelancer routes gained local proposal/checklist assets. No marketplace write action, inquiry, order, payout, or revenue occurred.
timeline_by_date.lesson: Prepared proposal routes still need explicit user confirmation for any platform write/account action.

timeline_by_date.summary: The project was slimmed into compact read-first files. The prior 30-minute heartbeat automation was deleted. Low-frequency waiting-lead monitoring was clarified as opportunistic only. XHS was dropped/skipped by user instruction. Upwork and Freelancer were moved to sunk/backlog because of pre-revenue cost gates, despite earlier Freelancer candidates.
timeline_by_date.lesson: Context control and cost gates matter; a candidate is not actionable if reaching the buyer requires unacceptable pre-revenue spend or account risk.

timeline_by_date.summary: Read-only Bilibili, LinkedIn, Douyin, and Weibo natural checkpoints produced no verified buyer/order/payment signal. USER_DECISION_QUEUE.md is CLEAR and revenue_ledger.csv still records 0 RMB.
timeline_by_date.lesson: Low-frequency checks are useful for not missing replies, but they must not become polling or replace fresh no-upfront-cost discovery.

current_bottleneck.summary: No verified revenue and no active order. Passive/inbound checks have not produced a screened buyer with budget and safe payment path.
current_bottleneck.decision_lock: No OPEN user decision in USER_DECISION_QUEUE.md.
sunk_or_backlog_platforms: Upwork: sunk/backlog because Connects or proposal costs may be required before revenue.
Freelancer: sunk/backlog because free bids are limited and minimum balance/payment gates may apply.
Xiaohongshu: skipped/backlog by user account-risk instruction.

next_safe_plan: Do not use this public-repo automation to advance acquisition.
In the money-goal project only, when no OPEN decision exists, continue one small read-only no-upfront-cost discovery step.
Avoid polling loops, countdowns, background waits, broad repeated scans, or generic offer-asset preparation before a concrete buyer demand appears.
Stop at login, CAPTCHA, KYC, SMS/QR, account, payment, payout, tax, cost, proposal, comment, DM, upload, or any other write/action gate.
If payment or payout appears, verify revenue in revenue_ledger.csv before counting progress.
hard_boundaries: Do not count views, favorites, posts, proposal drafts, prepared materials, platform setup, tips, donations, support payments, watch routes, or inquiries without order/payment as experiment revenue.
Do not solve CAPTCHA or ask for verification codes inside an automated maintenance task.
Do not pay for bids, membership, promotion, deposit, guarantee, platform credits, or Connects without explicit user confirmation.
Do not alter payment, tax, profile, contact, or account settings without explicit user confirmation.
Do not perform platform write actions from the daily progress automation.

file_policy.revenue_ledger.csv: Only revenue source of truth in the private money-goal project.

freshness_protocol: Before answering latest progress, current status, broke-zero status, or completion, refresh the public repository with git fetch/pull when network is available.
If pull is unavailable, blocked, or unsafe, read raw GitHub files when network is available.
If network is unavailable, answer from local files only with an explicit cached-copy caveat and include the local Updated timestamp or updated_at value.
